name: @plane/api-types
description: TypeScript types and enum values generated from the API's OpenAPI schemas

scripts.generate: openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/internal.yaml --enum-values -o src/generated/internal.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/admin.yaml --enum-values -o src/generated/admin.ts && openapi-typescript ../../apps/api/openapi/v1.yaml --enum-values -o src/generated/v1.ts
